purpose: Define the fail-closed successor to the Teacher3K heldout20 protocol for one exact base-versus-corrected-teacher-SFT comparison without copying private task content.

predecessor_protocol.compatibility_gap: Its valid_checkpoint_corpora contains only the three retired token-spliced manifests, so it cannot admit the corrected corpus until a new lineage receipt and protocol version bind that manifest.

execution_blueprint.use: Inherit only its frozen seeds, harness, sampling, zero-GPU source-Job shape, and exact-identity gates. Its retired 96K corpus and step-350 candidate are not inputs to this successor.

selection.source: Copy the exact 20 task rows from the predecessor protocol only after a fresh read-only lineage reconciliation proves all are absent from the accepted corrected corpus.

matched_identity_rule.only_allowed_arm_difference: The exact weight manifest and its directly derived model revision/served identifier.
must_match: non-weight serving files, precision, quantization, engine, image, arguments, and topology
exact task, environment, data, prompt, and verifier versions
harness image, OpenCode version, ordered tool schemas, context policy, and budgets
sampling, attempt seeds, concurrency, timeout, outcome classification, and replacement policy

outcome_policy.invalid_cell_replacement: Preserve the original and reacquire the whole paired base/candidate cell under one score-blind, predeclared immutable successor; never splice asymmetric cells.

readiness_gates: Bind the accepted corrected corpus manifest and a fresh heldout20 lineage reconciliation in a new immutable protocol version.
Bind the accepted integrated campaign-adapter and outcome-validity commit; neither open PR alone is an execution authority.
Bind accepted terminal checkpoint, BF16 export, staging, registration, and live-parity receipts for the corrected arm.

Reuse historical base rollouts only when every task, harness, route, non-weight serving, seed, budget, and outcome-validity binding is byte-for-byte compatible; otherwise run a fresh matched base arm.
Freeze the score-blind paired replacement policy and prove every exact output root, database, Job, ConfigMap, and launch claim is absent before create.
Require both server previews to contain the root annotation fleet.ai/failure-alerts=off before any Job creation.

reporting.per_task_metric: pass@4: at least one authoritative success among four valid attempts

analysis_contract.eligible_primary_pairs: All 13 clean development families with complete, outcome-valid paired base and corrected-teacher-SFT pass@4 cells after any predeclared whole-pair replacement.
analysis_contract.estimand: delta_dev=(1/13)*sum_i(corrected_pass4_i-base_pass4_i), the absolute paired task-family pass@4 risk difference for the exact terminal checkpoint versus the exact base.

primary_test.method: one-sided exact McNemar conditional binomial test
primary_test.p_value: Pr[Binomial(D,0.5)>=b] evaluated exactly; when D=0 set p=1

uncertainty.mapping_for_reporting: Also report the interval mapped to the observed-D paired risk-difference scale as (D/13)*(2*theta-1); label it conditional on observed D.
uncertainty.zero_discordance: When D=0, report delta_dev=0, theta as not estimable, the theta interval as [0,1], and the mapped interval as [0,0].

development_decision.positive: Only if all 13 primary pairs are valid, delta_dev>=3/13, and the one-sided exact p-value<=0.05.
development_decision.harm: Only if all 13 primary pairs are valid, delta_dev<=-3/13, and the reverse one-sided exact p-value<=0.05.
development_decision.otherwise: not confirmed; do not reinterpret as equivalence, benefit, or harm

final_test_role.unseal_condition: Unseal once only after the frozen dev13 positive rule passes; otherwise leave final7 sealed.
final_test_role.role: Independent one-shot generalization check, never a tuning, checkpoint-selection, or pooled-primary stratum.
final_test_role.reporting: Report the same paired delta, discordant counts, exact one-sided p-value, and conditional exact interval separately.
final_test_role.interpretation: Call the final result directionally consistent only when delta_final>=2/7; this descriptive label is not a second powered superiority claim. Otherwise report that final-set directional consistency was not observed. Never pool final7 with dev13 to rescue the primary decision.

analysis_contract.multiplicity: One primary dev13 superiority test. The final7 check and union20 summaries do not create additional confirmatory claims.
analysis_contract.training_seed_scope: One fixed training seed is evaluated. The estimand describes this exact trained checkpoint, not the expected effect of the training procedure across seeds.

required_outputs: paired task-level delta and uncertainty over tasks
reliability and outcome-validity counts by arm
